name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.phi_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff
summary: Apply φ^l to the lifting condition: φ^l moves the letter i to σ^l(i), standard exponents of level 0 to level l, and constantAt to constantAt.

steps.lean:
mem_liftIdeal_iff.trans (by
  simp_rw +singlePass [(MulAction.surjective (FrobGroup.φ ^ l)).exists]
  simp [smul_left_cancel_iff, mem_liftIdeal_iff, mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff, frobKisinAinf,
    ← phi_pow_smul_constantAt, smul_comm r, ← smul_sub, ← frobGroup_smul_smul,
    phi_pow_smul_mem_letterPart_iff, -nsmul_eq_mul])

steps.claim: write every element as φ^l of another (φ^l is bijective);

then φ^l(s − rt)·constantAt(S, σ^l(i))(c) = φ^l((s − rt)·constantAt(S, i)(c)) (phi_pow_smul_constantAt), φ^l x has the standard exponents of level l at σ^l(i) iff x has those of level 0 at i (mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff, frobKisinAinf, phi_pow_smul_mem_letterPart_iff), and projTriv commutes with φ^l.
steps.lean:
simp [smul_left_cancel_iff, mem_liftIdeal_iff, mem_withExponents_stdExponent_iff, frobKisinAinf,
    ← phi_pow_smul_constantAt, smul_comm r, ← smul_sub, ← frobGroup_smul_smul,
    phi_pow_smul_mem_letterPart_iff, -nsmul_eq_mul])
